systemName.description: System/project name, for the diagram's label.

actors.description: External actors of the Context level (Simon Brown). The Container level's containers do NOT go here: they come from the project's current module_map.

type.description: `person` (default) for whoever operates the system; `external_system` for another system it talks to (e.g. a Git provider).
